description: Use this first when asked for a meal plan. Returns daily calories, protein (1.9 g/kg default), fat (0.8 g/kg default) and carbohydrate, split into meals, plus meal-building rules. Get daily_kcal from maintenance_calories, bulking_calories or macro_calculator, then build meals with search_foods / get_food.
name: macro_meal_plan
title: Macro plan with per-meal targets
